action: Treat posts from Ukrinform's site and X account made around November 11 with caution. Media teams: review who holds admin access to your website and social accounts and turn on phishing-resistant sign-in.
exec: A state news outlet lost control of its main publishing channels, showing how media brands can be used to push hostile messaging.
impact: The agency's homepage and X account carried attacker content while services were being restored.
plain: Hackers took over the website front page and X account of Ukraine's state news agency and posted anti-Ukrainian messages. The agency is investigating with security services.
summary: Ukrinform said on November 11 that its IT systems were attacked. The homepage was swapped for an anti-Ukrainian message with a crossed-out flag and a Telegram link, and its X account was renamed with a pro-Russian slogan. The agency is working with the SBU and the state communications protection service. No attacker has been officially named.
title: Hackers deface Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform and hijack its X account

validation.note: Two Ukrainian outlets carry the agency's own statement; attribution is not confirmed.
